metadata.notes: Do not use this profile for real applications until required fields are completed and the user confirms.

education.graduation_window_policy: Confirmed by the user on 2026-09-05: the candidate can graduate at EITHER December 2026 or May 2027. Both endpoints are available choices, not a range the candidate happens to fall somewhere inside. Screening consequence: a posting is eligible on graduation grounds if it accepts either endpoint. 'Graduate in 2027' is satisfied by choosing May 2027; 'graduate in 2026' or 'December 2026' is satisfied by choosing December 2026; 'May/June 2027' is satisfied by May 2027; 'Fall 2026 or Spring 2027' is satisfied by either. Skip on graduation only when a posting requires a date that neither endpoint can meet, such as 2028 or Summer 2028. If no graduation requirement is listed, do not skip. Forms that demand one exact month are still a handoff to the user, since the candidate must pick one.

work_authorization.current_authorization: F-1 student status; authorized to work in the United States through OPT and eligible for the 3-year STEM OPT extension.
work_authorization.answer_exactly_as: Authorized to work in the United States: Yes. Will require employer visa sponsorship now or in the future: Yes.
work_authorization.notes_for_unclear_forms: If a form separates 'requires sponsorship now' from 'requires sponsorship in the future', ask the user before answering the 'now' question. If the form asks 'now or in the future', answer Yes.

targets.target_level: New grad / entry-level / level I only
roles_to_avoid: Job titles that explicitly say C++
Job titles that include PhD or postings that explicitly target/require PhD candidates

temporary_companies_to_avoid.reason: User requested excluding TikTok and ByteDance from lead finding and application review until 2027-01-01.

tier_1: California: San Francisco Bay Area, San Jose, Palo Alto, Mountain View, Sunnyvale, Los Angeles, Irvine/Orange County, San Diego
tier_2: New Jersey: Jersey City, Hoboken, Newark
Texas statewide: Fort Worth, Plano, Irving, Houston, San Antonio, Round Rock, Frisco, and other Texas locations

targets.location_ranking_policy: Prioritize CA, WA, NYC, Boston/Cambridge, Chicago, Minneapolis/St. Paul, Austin, and Dallas first; then strong tech hubs in other preferred states and Texas statewide; then remaining listed locations. Refresh location recommendations from public job-market signals during lead finding when web search is available.
targets.remote_hybrid_onsite_preference: Accept remote, hybrid, and onsite roles.
targets.relocation_policy: Target roles in listed preferred locations, with Tier 1 locations preferred. Texas is acceptable statewide. Ask before treating any other non-listed state as acceptable.

compensation.answer_strategy: For lead screening, skip a role only when its entire explicitly listed annual base salary range sits below 90,000 USD; a range that straddles 90,000 USD is acceptable. If compensation is not listed or is ambiguous, do not skip solely for compensation. For application forms, defer when allowed; otherwise ask before entering a required compensation field.
compensation.notes: User set the floor at 90,000 USD on 2026-08-28, replacing the 120,000 USD floor used from 2026-07-14. This settled the straddling-salary question that had been open since 2026-08-18.

resume_files.use_when: Use for Software Development Engineer, Software Engineer, SDE, and SWE roles. Markdown is preferred for fit review; PDF is preferred for upload; DOCX is preferred for editable source.

Use for AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Applied AI Engineer, and related early-career technical roles. Markdown is preferred for fit review; PDF is preferred for upload; DOCX is preferred for editable source.

intended_sources.linkedin: LinkedIn Jobs and LinkedIn Premium personal search
job_boards: Y Combinator Work at a Startup
company_career_page_sources: New grad / university / early career pages for target companies
intended_sources.source_policy: Use all listed sources for lead finding, including public Ashby hosted job boards and Ashby posting pages when available. LinkedIn Premium personal search is allowed only through an already-authenticated user session or user-provided/exported lead data; do not ask for credentials, bypass login/2FA/CAPTCHA, or open application flows. For account-heavy or slow sources such as Workday and Handshake, collect leads only unless the user confirms access and later approves application-flow use.

voluntary_self_identification.notes: Default to Prefer not to say / decline / leave blank when available unless the user explicitly wants exact answers stored in this private profile.

minimum_required_before_applications: resume file path and role family

china_track.scope: Roles based in mainland China at 外企 (foreign-invested multinationals with China offices). Chinese domestic companies are out of scope unless the user widens it. Hong Kong, Taiwan, Macau, and other non-mainland locations are neither track.
china_track.separation: Fully separate from the US track: separate CSVs, separate daily summaries, separate automation rules, separate counts. A posting belongs to exactly one track, decided by its work location.

work_authorization.current_authorization: 中国公民，在中国工作无需工作许可 (Chinese citizen; no work permit required to work in China).
work_authorization.screening_effect: Work authorization is not a screening axis on this track. Do not skip, flag, or ask about sponsorship, visa, or 工作许可 for China-based roles. This is the largest single difference from the US track.

compensation.answer_strategy: Skip only when the entire explicitly listed annual total package sits below 250,000 RMB; a range that straddles it is acceptable. Compensation is listed far less often in China than in the US, so do not skip when it is absent.

china_track.graduation_window: Unchanged: December 2026 through May 2027. In 校招 terms this straddles 2026届 (winter) and 2027届; keep postings that accept either.
china_track.priority_signal: 留学生专场 / 海外院校专场 postings rank highest: many 外企 run a separate overseas-graduate track, and the candidate studies in the US.

tier_3: Other mainland cities, case by case

china_track.excluded_companies_note: None. Confirmed by the user on 2026-09-05: no US exclusion carries over to this track. The US list was built for US-specific reasons, and the user has settled that none of it applies. Screen every 外企 on its own merits.
china_track.resume: English resume only. Confirmed by the user on 2026-09-05: no 中文简历 is needed and the existing English resume is used for 外企, same file as the US track. A 校招 form that forces Chinese is a handoff, not a reason to draft one.
china_track.ranking_against_us_track: None. Confirmed by the user on 2026-09-05: the two tracks are fully independent and neither takes priority. Do not rank China leads against US leads, call one a fallback for the other, or merge them into a shared queue or total.
china_track.internships: Out of scope. Confirmed by the user on 2026-09-05: 校招全职 is the sole entry point on the China track. 外企 China 日常实习 is typically a one-year full-time in-school placement for 研二/研三 students, which a December 2026 – May 2027 graduate cannot satisfy. Do not surface internships as an alternative or fallback.
